enterToPlot = {

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// The matrix, attempts and seed take effect on "Run chain"; the move is
// always-live. Burn-in only changes the summary, so it is always-live too.
committed = {
  plotTrigger
  const matrixRaw = (viewof matrixText).value
  const attemptsRaw = (viewof attemptsInput).value, seedRaw = (viewof seedInput).value
  const K = VM.expressions.makeNumber(window.math, attemptsRaw)
  const seed = VM.expressions.makeNumber(window.math, seedRaw)
  VM.ui.syncUrlParams({
    matrix: [matrixRaw, defaults.matrix], move: [moveSelect, defaults.move],
    attempts: [attemptsRaw, defaults.attempts], seed: [seedRaw, defaults.seed]
  })
  return {
    start: parseMatrix(matrixRaw), move: moveSelect,
    K: Number.isFinite(K) ? Math.min(20000, Math.max(10, Math.round(K))) : 2000,
    seed: Number.isFinite(seed) ? Math.round(seed) : 1
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
burnin = {
  const v = VM.expressions.makeNumber(window.math, burninInput)
  VM.ui.syncUrlParams({burnin: [burninInput, defaults.burnin]})
  return Number.isFinite(v) ? Math.max(0, Math.round(v)) : 500
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
result = {
  const {start, move, K, seed} = committed
  if (!start) return {ok: false, K}
  const run = runChain(start, {K, move, rng: VM.sampling.seededRandom(seed)})
  let lo = Infinity, hi = -Infinity
  for (const c of run.counts) { if (c < lo) lo = c; if (c > hi) hi = c }
  const pad = Math.max(5, (hi - lo) * 0.08)
  return {ok: true, ...run, K, move, startRows: rowSums(start), startCols: colSums(start), countRange: [lo - pad, hi + pad]}
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
setup = {
  const k = Math.min(Number(stepControl), result.K)
  if (!result.ok) return {ok: false, k}
  const m = stateAt(result, k)
  const after = Array.from(result.counts.subarray(Math.min(burnin, result.K) + 1))
  const obs = result.counts[0]
  let accepted = 0
  for (let t = 0; t < k; t++) accepted += result.flipped[t]
  const summary = {k, m, obs, now: result.counts[k], accepted, rows: rowSums(m), cols: colSums(m)}
  if (after.length > 0) {
    summary.mean = after.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / after.length
    summary.p = (1 + after.filter(c => c >= obs).length) / (after.length + 1)
  }
  if (k > 0) summary.pick = {cells: Array.from(result.picks.subarray(4 * (k - 1), 4 * k)), flipped: result.flipped[k - 1] === 1}
  return {ok: true, ...summary}
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
mainPlot = {
  const Plotly = window.Plotly
  let _plotDiv = null

  return (setup) => {
    const data = [], shapes = []
    const layout = {
      hovermode: "closest", uirevision: "static", autosize: true, shapes,
      margin: {l: 64, r: 16, t: 16, b: 48},
      xaxis: {domain: [0, 1], anchor: "y", showgrid: false, zeroline: false, showline: false, ticks: "", showticklabels: false, fixedrange: true},
      yaxis: {domain: [0.4, 1], anchor: "x", showgrid: false, zeroline: false, showline: false, ticks: "", showticklabels: false, fixedrange: true, scaleanchor: "x", constrain: "domain"},
      xaxis2: {domain: [0, 1], anchor: "y2", title: {text: "attempt", standoff: 4}},
      yaxis2: {domain: [0, 0.3], anchor: "x2", title: {text: "checkerboards", standoff: 8}, nticks: 4}
    }

    if (!setup.ok) {
      layout.annotations = VM.plotting.emptyState("Couldn't read the matrix: give 2–20 rows of 0s and 1s, all the same length.")
    } else {
      const {rows, cols} = result
      const z = Array.from({length: rows}, (_, i) => Array.from(setup.m.cells.subarray(i * cols, (i + 1) * cols)))
      data.push({
        z, type: "heatmap", xaxis: "x", yaxis: "y", showscale: false, xgap: 2, ygap: 2, zmin: 0, zmax: 1,
        colorscale: [[0, VM.plotting.alpha("muted", 0.15)], [1, chartColors.fn]],
        hovertemplate: "row %{y}, column %{x}: %{z}<extra></extra>"
      })
      // Row sums to the right, column sums below; a sum the move changed is
      // drawn in the alt color.
      const sumColor = (now, start) => now === start ? chartColors.ink : chartColors.alt
      data.push({
        x: Array(rows).fill(cols + 0.1), y: [...Array(rows).keys()], text: setup.rows.map(String),
        type: "scatter", mode: "text", xaxis: "x", yaxis: "y", showlegend: false, hoverinfo: "skip",
        textfont: {color: setup.rows.map((s, i) => sumColor(s, result.startRows[i]))}, textposition: "middle right"
      })
      data.push({
        x: [...Array(cols).keys()], y: Array(cols).fill(rows + 0.15), text: setup.cols.map(String),
        type: "scatter", mode: "text", xaxis: "x", yaxis: "y", showlegend: false, hoverinfo: "skip",
        textfont: {color: setup.cols.map((s, j) => sumColor(s, result.startCols[j]))}, textposition: "bottom center"
      })
      layout.xaxis.range = [-0.6, cols + 0.9]
      layout.yaxis.range = [rows + 0.9, -0.6]

      // The cells the last attempt looked at.
      if (setup.pick) {
        const [i, j, a, b] = setup.pick.cells
        const line = {color: setup.pick.flipped ? chartColors.warn : chartColors.muted, width: 3, dash: setup.pick.flipped ? "solid" : "dot"}
        if (j < 0) {
          shapes.push({type: "rect", xref: "x", yref: "y", x0: -0.5, x1: cols - 0.5, y0: i - 0.5, y1: i + 0.5, line})
        } else {
          for (const r of [i, j]) for (const c of [a, b]) {
            shapes.push({type: "rect", xref: "x", yref: "y", x0: c - 0.5, x1: c + 0.5, y0: r - 0.5, y1: r + 0.5, line})
          }
        }
      }

      // The count over the whole run (faint), up to k (solid), burn-in shaded.
      const ts = [...Array(result.K + 1).keys()]
      shapes.push({type: "rect", xref: "x2", yref: "y2", x0: 0, x1: Math.min(burnin, result.K), y0: result.countRange[0], y1: result.countRange[1], fillcolor: VM.plotting.alpha("muted", 0.12), line: {width: 0}, layer: "below"})
      data.push({x: ts, y: Array.from(result.counts), xaxis: "x2", yaxis: "y2", type: "scatter", mode: "lines", showlegend: false, hoverinfo: "skip", line: {color: VM.plotting.alpha("muted", 0.35), width: 1}})
      data.push({
        x: ts.slice(0, setup.k + 1), y: Array.from(result.counts.subarray(0, setup.k + 1)), xaxis: "x2", yaxis: "y2",
        type: "scatter", mode: "lines", name: "checkerboards", showlegend: false, line: {color: chartColors.fn, width: 1.5},
        hovertemplate: "attempt %{x}<br>%{y} checkerboards<extra></extra>"
      })
      data.push({x: [setup.k], y: [setup.now], xaxis: "x2", yaxis: "y2", type: "scatter", mode: "markers", showlegend: false, hoverinfo: "skip", marker: {color: chartColors.warn, size: 9, line: {color: chartColors.halo, width: 1}}})
      layout.xaxis2.range = [0, result.K]
      layout.yaxis2.range = result.countRange
    }

    const config = VM.plotting.config()
    if (!_plotDiv) {
      _plotDiv = document.createElement("div")
      _plotDiv.className = "plotly-box-large"
      Plotly.newPlot(_plotDiv, data, layout, config)
      VM.plotting.autoResize(_plotDiv)
    } else {
      Plotly.react(_plotDiv, data, layout, config)
    }
    return _plotDiv
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
stats = {
  if (!setup.ok) return VM.ui.statRow([{label: "Checkerboards", value: "—"}])
  const items = [
    {label: "Checkerboards now", value: setup.now.toLocaleString()},
    {label: "Observed", value: setup.obs.toLocaleString()},
    {label: "Moves that changed it", value: setup.k ? `${setup.accepted} of ${setup.k}` : "—"},
    {label: "Mean after burn-in", value: setup.mean === undefined ? "—" : setup.mean.toFixed(1)}
  ]
  if (result.move === "swap") items.push({label: "p̂ after burn-in", value: setup.p === undefined ? "—" : setup.p.toPrecision(2), title: "(1 + #{counts ≥ observed}) / (attempts + 1) over the attempts after burn-in. Successive states are correlated, so this is rougher than its count suggests."})
  return VM.ui.statRow(items)
}
```

```{ojs}
// The checkerboard counts after burn-in, with the observed count marked.
histogramPlot = {
  if (!result.ok) return document.createElement("div")
  const after = Array.from(result.counts.subarray(Math.min(burnin, result.K) + 1), c => ({c}))
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 340, height: 260, marginLeft: 46,
    x: {label: "checkerboards"},
    y: {label: "attempts"},
    marks: [
      Plot.rectY(after, Plot.binX({y: "count"}, {x: "c", fill: chartColors.fn, fillOpacity: 0.6})),
      Plot.ruleX([result.counts[0]], {stroke: chartColors.ink, strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  })
}
```

```{ojs}
// How correlated the count is with itself a given number of attempts later.
autocorrelationPlot = {
  if (!result.ok) return document.createElement("div")
  const values = Array.from(result.counts.subarray(Math.min(burnin, result.K) + 1))
  const acf = values.length > 2 ? VM.mcmc.autocorrelation(values, 200) : []
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 340, height: 260, marginLeft: 46,
    x: {label: "lag (attempts)"},
    y: {label: "autocorrelation", domain: [-0.2, 1]},
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
      Plot.lineY(acf.map((r, lag) => ({lag, r})), {x: "lag", y: "r", stroke: chartColors.fn, strokeWidth: 2})
    ]
  })
}
```
